scope: Every screenshot referenced by a published central-catalogue app with the macos platform. Hidden entries are excluded. Some cross-platform apps show their existing Linux or Android interface, as documented in captions or provenance.
reviewMethod: Review visible pixels and source fixture/capture evidence. New captures use invented data or empty isolated defaults; retained game, generated-artwork and public-demo images are identified separately. Public-demo provenance is described without claiming a reproduced synthetic fixture. SHA-256 binds the review to these exact image bytes; it is not an automated personal-data detector.
